notes: Descriptions are written like video-scene lines (one sentence, well under SigLIP's 64-token text limit). searchQuery is a short keyword query for Pixabay; it is deliberately NOT the description, because the real pipeline searches with keywords. visualTarget is what a human reviewer should look for.
candidatePickRule: One Pixabay search per scene (image_type=photo, safesearch=true, per_page=20, default order). Candidates are taken at evenly spaced result positions (0-based 0,4,8,12,16 when 20 hits are returned) so the set mixes strong and weaker matches. The rule is fixed in advance and does not use SigLIP.

scenes.description: A crowded stock exchange trading floor where traders shout and watch rows of screens.
scenes.visualTarget: Many people on a trading floor with screens or trading posts; not a single laptop chart or a generic office.

scenes.description: Workers installing solar panels on a large solar farm.
scenes.visualTarget: People physically installing or working on panels in a utility-scale array; not a lone rooftop panel or a close-up of one cell.

scenes.description: A crane loading shipping containers onto a cargo ship at a commercial port.
scenes.visualTarget: Containers, a crane or gantry, and a vessel at a working port; not an empty beach or a single parked truck.

scenes.description: Engineers in hard hats inspecting industrial machinery in a factory.
scenes.visualTarget: People inspecting heavy equipment in an industrial setting; not a stock-style office handshake or a machine with nobody near it.

scenes.description: A farmer examining drought-damaged crops in a dry field.
scenes.visualTarget: A person looking at wilted or dried crops on parched ground; not healthy green fields or an empty cracked-earth close-up.

scenes.description: A data centre filled with long rows of server racks.
scenes.visualTarget: An interior of server racks in rows; not a single desktop PC or an abstract network illustration.

scenes.description: An aerial view of heavy traffic congestion on the roads of a major city.
scenes.visualTarget: Elevated or drone view of dense, slow or stopped traffic in a city; not a ground-level view of a single car.

scenes.description: A laboratory technician examining samples with a microscope.
scenes.visualTarget: A person in a lab examining samples (microscope, test tubes, slides); not a bare lab bench or a classroom.

scenes.description: A warehouse where automated equipment sorts packages on conveyor belts.
scenes.visualTarget: Conveyors or robotic sorting of parcels in a warehouse; not shelves with nobody and nothing moving, not a delivery van.

scenes.description: An electricity transmission substation with transformers and high-voltage power lines.
scenes.visualTarget: A substation yard with transformers or switchgear and lines; not a single pylon in a landscape or a household socket.
